entries.035af94bb992269b: This business makes and sells magnetic heads and suspensions for hard disk drives (HDDs), as well as magnets. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥262,903 million, accounting for 10.5% of the total. Segment profit for the same year was ¥26,951 million. The company explains that sales volume for HDD magnetic heads for data center nearline HDDs increased by about 14%, and for HDD suspensions by about 35%, resulting in a substantial increase in revenue and profit. The main companies include the company itself, SAE Magnetics (H.K.) Ltd., Magnecomp Precision Technology Public Co., Ltd., Headway Technologies, Inc., TDK Philippines Corporation, and Acrathon Precision Technologies (HK) Ltd., and including the company, 16 companies belong to it.

entries.069e3d9616edbd28: It develops and produces electronic components and rechargeable batteries, sells them to companies that manufacture equipment, and earns net sales. The reporting [[term:segment|segments]] are the 4 of "Passive Components," "Sensor Application Products," "Magnetic Application Products" and "Energy Application Products," and businesses not included in these are classified as "Other." Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,370,304 million for Energy Application Products, ¥593,201 million for Passive Components, ¥262,903 million for Magnetic Application Products, ¥224,623 million for Sensor Application Products, and ¥53,789 million for Other, for a total of ¥2,504,820 million. The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that its main customers are "ICT-related companies operating globally, automobile and automobile parts manufacturers, home appliance and industrial equipment manufacturers, etc." Components do not reach consumers on their own, but are incorporated into and used in the equipment of these companies. Overseas net sales were ¥2,321,360 million, and the ratio of overseas net sales to consolidated net sales was 92.7%.

entries.14092f51c8916309: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥272,415 million, an increase of 21.5% from ¥224,192 million in the previous fiscal year. The breakdown of segment profit is ¥246,682 million for Energy Application Products, ¥41,831 million for Passive Components, ¥26,951 million for Magnetic Application Products, ¥20,748 million for Sensor Application Products, and a loss of ¥10,230 million for Other, with a deduction of an adjustment of ¥53,567 million for corporate operating and administrative expenses and other items added to this. Profit before tax was ¥276,810 million, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥195,663 million. The company explains that foreign exchange fluctuations resulted in an overall decrease in net sales of about ¥2.5 billion and a decrease in operating profit of about ¥10.6 billion.

entries.265340b4575de8c4: This business manufactures and sells secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries that can be used repeatedly) and power supplies. The main products are small batteries for smartphones, medium-sized batteries for industrial equipment, and power supplies for industrial equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,370,304 million, accounting for 54.7% of the total for the 4 reportable segments and other, making it the largest business.
